query: What teacher incentive and policy negotiation strategies are most effective to minimize dropout and align intervention workload with local education systems?

response.query: What teacher incentive and policy negotiation strategies are most effective to minimize dropout and align intervention workload with local education systems?
response.answer: Effective teacher incentives include performance-based pay and professional development opportunities. Negotiation strategies should focus on aligning intervention efforts with local education policies and reducing workload through collaborative planning. These strategies aim to minimize dropout and enhance teacher engagement.

results.content: While most countries report that most of their schools use such learning management systems, at least at some educational level, about half of them are not interoperable with system-level student information systems and require schools to manually provide information to their public authorities/ministries, and in turn are unable to receive any insight from the data collected at the jurisdictional level [(Vincent-Lancrin, 2023[25])](/en/publications/oecd-digital-education-outlook-2023_c74f03de-en/full-report/towards-a-digital-transformation-of-education-distance-travelled-and-journey-ahead_84a6abf5.html#Vin232_8b599c777b).
